args.title: Document the integer parsing in parseAmount to avoid floats
args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

The `parseAmount` function parses monetary amounts into integers in minor units to prevent floating-point imprecision. It handles currencies without minor units, like JPY, by storing as whole numbers. This approach prevents rounding errors due to floating-point representation.
